introHtml: Can badge ID holders, often called can badge holders, are designed to hold standard ID badges securely in a clear, durable pouch. Unlike simple clip-on holders, can badge holders feature a rigid or semi-rigid back that keeps badges flat and protected, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate security, and daily employee use. Choose from options with hang holes, bulldog clips, or pin backs for easy attachment to lanyards or uniforms. Custom imprint your logo for professional branding.
